notes:
## Changelog
### Fixed
- Fixed exe file not actually getting replaced when using the updater.

## Changelog
### Added
- Added blank Carrier layout template.
- Added carrier layout template for Case 1 conditions.
- Added carrier layout template for Case 3 conditions.

### Fixed
- Fixed update download can be truncated.
- Fixed editing strip can raise KeyError if controller deletes or transfers strip.
- Fixed breakout inserts strips in the wrong place with several controllers.
- Fixed the host's cursor jumps to the end while typing in Notes and combos.
- Fixed flash timer is never stopped or started after remote updates.
- Fixed headless server banner can crash on non-UTF-8 output

### Changed
- Changed generate squawk to no longer produce emergency squawks (7500/7600/7700).
- Reorganized menu layout options.
- Completely reworked how server and client connections talk to each other.
  - Added heartbeat for better accidental disconnect detection.
  - Added better auto-reconnect logic.
  - Added popup to indicate when you have unexpectedly disconnected
  - Added better logic to try and recover state when a controller how unexpectedly disconnects, reconnects.
- Changed logos for server and client.

## Changelog
- Fixed breaking out a strip doesn't regenerate CID.
- Fixed duplicating a column or duplicating a split, copy squawk and CID.
- Fixed server client handshake is delayed by the "Connected" popup.
- Fixed column rename de-syncs UI from model.
- Fixed strips keep the old column name after column rename.
- Fixed "remove field" button can't remove border boxes on strip layout editor.
- Fixed profile switcher shows "(unsaved)" for saved custom profiles.
- Fixed "check for updates" gives no feedback when you're up to date.
- Fixed cloning a preset silently overwrites an existing custom layout.
- Fixed collapse dialog offers strips owned by other controllers.
- Fixed stopping a server doesn't properly disconnects all clients in certain scenarios.
- Fixed offline strips get hidden after connecting to a server.
- Fixed deleting a column deletes other controllers' strips.
- Fixed a rejected transfer leaves the strip on the rejecter's board.
- Fixed renaming the default layout can leave a dead default path.
- Fixed overlapping update checks read the wrong reply.
- Fixed the first dialog edit silently changes Type from "" to "Unknown".
- Fixed bulk add accepts invalid squawks.
- Fixed overview tab rebuilding every strip on every edit, even when hidden.
- Added ability to create a strip or spacer (more specifically when using keybinds) go to the column you are hovering with your mouse, not just the first column.
- Added changelog history to show list of changes by update, not just latest update.
- Changed column duplication to no longer duplicate any spacers or strips inside it,.

## Changelog
- HOTFIX: Fixed issue with open layout button not doing anything.

## Changelog
- HOTFIX: Crash on startup do to bad import of old layout types

## Changelog
- Fixed Marshall bearing being 180 off of Final Bearing, not BRC
- Added modex to be displayed alongside callsign on controller overview
- Added modex to be displayed alongside callsign on Strip Collapse dialog
- Added audible alert on incoming transfer offer
- Added status bar connection indicator
- Fixed duplicate strip-move history entries when hosting
- Fixed layout/profile names aren't filesystem-sanitized
- Fixed autosave isn't crash-safe
- Fixed saving a layout under an existing name silently overwrites it
- Fixed closing the main window while hosting drops connected controllers with no warning

## Changelog
- Organizing the logs and files in the temp directory

## Changelog
- Adding versioning printouts to the headless server
- Bumped the minimum required protocol version to 17
  - Any protocol version lower than 17 is incompatible, and connections will be rejected.

## Changelog
- Fixed collapse dialog crashes on strips with no callsign
- Fixed a corrupt settings file stops the app from launching
- Fixed edit strip dialog silently changes data
- Fixed bulk add uppercases the aircraft type
- Fixed any layout rebuild shows other controllers' strips
- Fixed dragging down within a column lands one slot too far
- Fixed host keeps stale widgets when a remote client deletes, breaks out or collapses a strip
- Fixed editable combos on strips never commit typed text
- Fixed zero-padded values lose padding after opening and closing an editor
- Fixed column deletion is by name, and Split doesn't check for duplicate names
- Fixed autosave doesn't contain any strips
- Fixed keybind dialog: cancel doesn't revert changes
- Fixed server and connect dialogs are recreated on every open
- Fixed client reconnect counts each drop twice
- Fixed typing an airfield ICAO overwrites other controllers' info blocks
- Fixed Headless server can crash on exit
- Fixed updater not actually installing the newest update.
- Changed create column default keybind from "C" to "T"
- Changed create carrier strip default keybind from "" to "C"
- Added changelog notes to the dialog that prompts user that a new latest version is available

## Changelog
- Renamed the field "Bort Number" to "Modex" 
  - Any previous custom strip layout using "Bort Numbers" will need to be fixed to reflect the new name being "Modex"
- Added new field "Holding Hands"
  - Represents the strips wingmen, helpful for carrier operations
  - A list containing other "Modex"'s
  - Breaking out strips populates the "Modex" properly,
  - Condensing strips populates "Holding Hands" properly
- Edited Strip layout "FAA_Styles" to account for "Modex"
- Edited Strip layout "FAA_Styles" to include "Holding Hands"

## Changelog
- Potentially fixed issue with the updater not actually updating the application to the latest version.

## Changelog:
- Fixed potential crash after reloading into session with existing strips.
- Fixed issue of strips broken out not getting all data the root strip had.
- Added aircraft type to carrier strip on FAA_Style preset
- Added a preset for carrier board layout.

## Changelog:
- Added a new updater function
  - on startup will check the latest version here.

## Notes:
First public release! _Technicality an old build as 0.16.2 will be the actual latest, but im adding the one before to test checking for latest and grabbing the proper version._

## **Changelog:**
- Fixed bug with controller overview getting out of sync due to transferred strips not properly signalling to the server.
- Added a new dialog to allow for bulk importing/creating of strips.
- Changed the field "Aircraft Type" to be a dropdown instead of a pure text edit line. 
  - Added a good chunk of flyable DCS fixed wing aircraft to the dropdown list.
